metadata.title: Open Pickleball Research Commons v0.3: Context-and-Provenance Candidate Supporting Materials
metadata.description: Versioned supporting package for the Current Opinion 'Outcome Harmonization Needs Context and Provenance: A Research Commons for Cumulative Pickleball Science'. Includes a 28-record AI-assisted demonstration corpus, its codebook, the pre-consensus PR-MDS v0.3 specification and dictionary, and a JSON validation schema with four-publication stress-test examples. The corpus is non-systematic and single-coded; PR-MDS is not an established standard, reporting guideline, core outcome set, certification scheme, or consensus product.
